headline: Libya Restarts Marsa al-Brega Oil Refinery After Years of Outages
summary: Libya's National Oil Corporation announced the restart of the Marsa al-Brega refinery, which had been halted since April 2017 due to a distillation-tower fault.
why: Restoring domestic refining capacity in OPEC member nations can alter regional product balances and affect national export revenues. Libya holds some of Africa's largest crude reserves.

impacts.name: Oil Refining
impacts.why: The return of the Brega refinery increases local processing capacity and fuel supply.
